title: Handwerksbetrieb

impressumPatterns.law: DDG § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 lit. a; DL-InfoV § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 6
impressumPatterns.note: Kammer is mandatory for reglementierte Berufe. ZDH/HWK Köln treat it as mandatory for Gesundheitshandwerke and recommended for other Anlage-A trades; eRecht24 treats it as mandatory for all. Hence WARN, see pruefen.

impressumPatterns.law: DDG § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 lit. b; DL-InfoV § 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 6
impressumPatterns.note: gesetzliche Berufsbezeichnung plus the state that awarded it (Deutschland). Handwerksrolle/Betriebsnummer is the usual way HWK templates phrase it.
Name of the berufsrechtliche Regelung (HwO) and how it is accessible; HWK templates name the HwO and link gesetze-im-internet.de.

statements.note: Only if a Berufshaftpflichtversicherung exists: insurer name, address and räumlicher Geltungsbereich. May also be given via offer/PDF (§ 2 Abs. 2 DL-InfoV), so absence on the site alone is not a violation.

Statement whether the business is willing/obliged to take part in Verbraucherschlichtung, on the website or with the AGB. Exempt with <= 10 employees on 31.12. of the previous year (§ 36 Abs. 3), which the gate cannot verify. Frequent Abmahnung subject for larger Betriebe.

statements.law: BGB § 312b Abs. 1, § 312g Abs. 1, § 357a; Art. 246a § 1 Abs. 2 S. 1 Nr. 1 und 3 EGBGB
statements.note: Consumers get a 14-day Widerrufsrecht for contracts closed online or at their home (Vor-Ort-Auftrag). Without correct Belehrung the period never starts and Wertersatz for work already done is lost (§ 357a). Exception only for expressly requested urgent repairs (§ 312g Abs. 2 Nr. 11).

statements.law: Art. 246a § 1 Abs. 1 S. 1 Nr. 9 EGBGB; BGB § 634a Abs. 1 (2 Jahre Werk / 5 Jahre Bauwerk)
statements.note: Hint that gesetzliche Mängelhaftung exists is part of the pre-contract information for distance/off-premises contracts; statutory periods must not be shortened towards consumers.
Prices shown to consumers (Stundensatz, Anfahrtspauschale) must be Gesamtpreise incl. USt. Only relevant when the page shows amounts; the gate cannot condition on that, hence WARN.

requiredLinks.note: berufsrechtliche Regelungen must be accessible; a link to the HwO on gesetze-im-internet.de is the accepted way (HWK Köln template).

forbiddenWords.law: Verordnung (EU) 2024/3228 (Aufhebung VO (EU) Nr. 524/2013, wirksam 20.07.2025); UWG § 5 Abs. 1
forbiddenWords.note: The EU ODR platform was shut down on 20.07.2025; keeping the hint/link misleads consumers and is an active Abmahnung subject. The VSBG § 36 statement stays mandatory.

forbiddenWords.law: UWG § 5 Abs. 1, Abs. 2 Nr. 3; HwO § 51 Abs. 1
forbiddenWords.note: Allowed only when the Inhaber/Betriebsleiter passed the Meisterprüfung in that trade (title is personal, HwO § 51). The gate cannot verify, hence WARN; false use is a classic Abmahnung.
Membership claims (Innung, Fachverband) must be true and current; verify against the Innung register.

forbiddenWords.law: PAngV § 3 Abs. 1, § 2 Nr. 3; UWG § 5 Abs. 2 Nr. 2
forbiddenWords.note: Net prices towards consumers violate the Gesamtpreis duty. WARN because a mixed B2B/B2C site may legitimately show net prices in a clearly B2B-only section.

A Garantie is a voluntary promise beyond Gewährleistung and needs stated conditions (scope, duration, who guarantees). Vague Garantie claims mislead; must not be confused with the statutory Mängelhaftung.

manual: Anlage-A trade (Maler, Elektro, SHK, Dachdecker, Tischler...) requires Handwerksrolle entry before operating/advertising (HwO § 1 Abs. 1; Bußgeld bis 10.000 EUR, § 117). Check the HWK Betriebsnummer.

Aufsichtsbehörde (DDG § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 3) only where a behördliche Zulassung is needed: in Handwerk essentially bevollmächtigte Bezirksschornsteinfeger and Büchsenmacher (ZDH). Schornsteinfegerarbeiten only by Betriebe in the Handwerksrolle (SchfHwG § 2 Abs. 1).

Elektro: work behind the Hausanschlusssicherung only by a company entered in a Netzbetreiber Installateurverzeichnis (NAV § 13 Abs. 2). Gas/SHK: same for Gasanlagen (NDAV § 13 Abs. 2). Any 'eingetragener Installateur' claim must be true.

Vor-Ort-Aufträge and online orders: hand over Widerrufsbelehrung + Muster-Widerrufsformular and obtain the consumer's express request to start early, otherwise no Wertersatz (§ 357a BGB, Art. 246a § 1 Abs. 2 EGBGB). Exception § 312g Abs. 2 Nr. 11 only for urgent repairs the customer explicitly asked for.

VSBG: count employees on 31.12. of the previous year; > 10 employees makes the § 36 Abs. 1 Nr. 1 statement mandatory. Name the Schlichtungsstelle if the Betrieb is willing/obliged (§ 36 Abs. 1 Nr. 2).

DL-InfoV information (§ 2 Abs. 1 Nr. 1-11) may be given via offer/Kostenvoranschlag instead of the website (§ 2 Abs. 2). DL-InfoV § 4 price duties do not apply towards consumers (§ 4 Abs. 2); PAngV governs.

PAngV § 12 Abs. 1: a Preisverzeichnis for wesentliche Leistungen or Verrechnungssätze (Stundensatz incl. USt) must be displayed in the Geschäftsräume unless work is only offered via individual written Angebot/Kostenvoranschlag (§ 12 Abs. 4 Nr. 1).
Meister wording: title is personal (HwO § 51 Abs. 1). 'Meisterbetrieb' only if the person running the Betrieb holds the Meisterprüfung for that trade; check Betriebsleiter and Handwerksrolle entry.
AGB clauses shortening Gewährleistung below BGB § 634a periods or excluding Widerruf are void towards consumers; review AGB with the HWK Rechtsberatung.
pruefen: Whether every Anlage-A Handwerk is a 'reglementierter Beruf' under DDG § 5 Abs. 1 Nr. 5 (reference to RL 89/48/EWG, 92/51/EWG). ZDH and HWK Köln make Kammer/Berufsbezeichnung/HwO mandatory only for Gesundheitshandwerke and recommend it otherwise; eRecht24 says mandatory for all Handwerker. Pack uses WARN; lawyer to decide FAIL vs WARN.

OLG Düsseldorf decision on 'Meisterbetrieb' cited in press without Aktenzeichen; rueden.de cites OLG Frankfurt 09.12.2009, 6 U 178/08 (advertising without Handwerksrolle was NOT held misleading on appeal). Confirm current case law before escalating meister-claim to FAIL.
Art. 246a § 1 EGBGB numbering (Abs. 1 S. 1 Nr. 9 Gewährleistung; Abs. 2 S. 1 Nr. 1 und 3) taken from dejure.org (version effective 19.06.2026), gesetze-im-internet URL returned 404; verify verbatim.
Whether 'netto'/'zzgl. MwSt' on a mixed-audience Handwerk site is a PAngV violation depends on whether the offer is addressed to consumers (PAngV § 1 Abs. 1); no Handwerk-specific ruling verified.
HWK Betriebsnummer in the Impressum: no statutory duty found, only HWK template practice; pattern 'berufsbezeichnung' accepts it as an alternative wording.
PAngV § 12 Abs. 1 Sätze 2-4 (Stundensatz/Kilometersatz incl. USt) summarized from gesetze-im-internet, not quoted verbatim; verify exact text.
VSBG § 36 Abs. 3 headcount exemption: confirm whether Auszubildende and Teilzeitkräfte count as 'Personen' for the 10-employee threshold.
